issues.description: The problem statement and UML refer to a SealSaloon method named checkOrderReady(), but the reference solution implements this functionality in a method named processOrders(). This identifier mismatch can confuse students about the exact method name they must implement and may cause tests or grader code expecting checkOrderReady() to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution and the problem statement use the same method name. Either rename the solution method processOrders() to checkOrderReady() (and keep the same implementation), or add a public checkOrderReady() method that delegates to processOrders(). Update any references and documentation so the expected method name is consistent.
